title: One Owl Eats Over 1,600 of the Same Animal a Year
subject: snowy owl

scenes.text: One owl can eat over 1,600 of the same animal in a single year.
It's the snowy owl, and the meal is the lemming. Three to five of them every single day.
Most owls hunt at night. Snowy owls hunt in broad daylight, perched, still, and watching.
Its eyesight and hearing can find prey hidden under snow and vegetation.
When lemmings get scarce, some of these owls fly south to find food.
A bird with a wingspan over four feet, living off one small rodent.

description:
